main_text.head: POCILLI DONVM,
EIDEM.
main_text.p: DOstarum[?] potis Elegantiarum Beza magnificas referre laudes, Pocillum artificis fagaciore Mitto Dædalei[?] manu politum: Vicinique tui fauente torno. Quod vix excipiat cauo pusillo Flentis lachrymulam unicam puelli. Quod vix ventriculo queat minuto Roris exiguam tenere guttam. Quo formica suam labore fessa Iugi parvula vix sitim levarit. Quo nec florilega fagax proboscis Mergi posset apis calente sole: Nec arguta femel cicada siccas Cantu perpetuo rigare fauces. Vix illo valeat culex iacere, Aut pulex tenuis latere totus. O si tam modicis, minutulisque Pauxillo madidis mero cululis Decertare modo iuuaret acres Potores: neque poculo liceret Provocare viros capaciore! Laudarent Sapido politiores Vates Teutonici fuos: nec unquam Tam charis biberent merum popinis.

page.notes: DOstarum: the initial word is doubtful; the long-s form could be read several ways, so it is marked [?]. Dædalei: the diphthong is partly obscured in the scan and is marked [?]. Beza: printed with a ligature-like form on the z. Signature "I. I." is printed at the foot right, with an ornament beside it, not transcribed.
